02 Round microscope

What exactly happens in one round?

Open the algorithm—not a black box. These are the implemented data-flow contracts; execution isolation depends on the selected mode.

01
↓

Broadcast

The coordinator sends the current ordered ResNet-18 parameter arrays to participating clients.

global_state → clients
02
∇

Train by partition

Each logical center optimizes inverse-frequency weighted cross-entropy through its partition-scoped loader.

no image payload is sent
03
σ

Protect, if enabled

Opacus clips each image’s gradient to C, adds Gaussian noise σC, and counts logical steps.

record-level DP-SGD per center
04
↑

Return updates

Clients return model parameters and partition cardinality—not raw images. Non-private demos also expose aggregate run telemetry.

parameters + n + status
05
Σ

Aggregate

FedAvg weights each client update by its training-partition cardinality to create the next model.

w ← Σ nᵢwᵢ / Σ nᵢ
06
✓

Evaluate centrally

The current coordinator evaluates on a pooled held-out test loader after every round.

known methodology limitation
Payload lens Boundary inspection

What enters an update payload—and what does not

Included in the protocol
  • Ordered model parameter arrays
  • Partition cardinality used for aggregation weights
  • Fit duration and aggregate metrics in non-private mode
  • DP step count and sampling rate in DP mode
Excluded from update payloads
  • Raw dermoscopy images
  • Per-image labels and predictions
  • Per-image gradients
  • Dataset file paths

Precise scope: the six-center path is a logical federation in one process and does not enforce storage isolation. The localhost Flower path demonstrates transport and process separation, but all processes share one account and configured data root. The coordinator mounts pooled test data for evaluation; moving evaluation to clients is a planned upgrade.

03 Privacy frontier lab

Tune a guarantee, then measure utility

The accountant can calculate privacy. It cannot predict accuracy; only a completed training run can measure that.

ε = accountant(q, σ, steps, δ)

How the controls affect training

Target epsilon, ε
The maximum cumulative privacy-loss bound. Lower is tighter. Target mode solves for σ before training.
Delta, δ
A small relaxation in the reported guarantee. At fixed σ it changes ε only; in this target-ε UI it recalibrates σ, so it can change gradients and measured accuracy.
Noise, σ
Gaussian noise relative to clipping C. More noise spends privacy more slowly and can make learning harder.
Clip norm, C
Caps each image-gradient norm and sets absolute noise σC. At fixed σ, C does not change formal ε.
Current configured plan

Projected ε by center

δ = 10⁻⁵

Choose DP-FedAvg in the lab to calculate the full planned schedule.

Assurance boundary: this is record-level DP-SGD at each center—a per-center guarantee against the coordinator, not client-level DP. Top-line ε reports completed rounds; per-center status records spend immediately after each completed update. Central test evaluation, partition metadata and technical status are outside the budget, and the ledger resets between runs. The research runtime separates DP randomness from the published experiment seed, but uses Opacus secure_mode=false; production needs CSPRNG-backed noise, a persistent cross-run composition ledger and a reviewed public-metadata policy.

05 Physical deployment

A Raspberry Pi makes the bottleneck real

The recorded hardware path runs Flower processes on a laptop and Raspberry Pi 5. It proves cross-device execution and exposes straggler behavior—not hospital-scale or clinical readiness.

Full model8.28 s
median local-fit repetition on Pi
Frozen backbone0.92 s
8.99× faster on device
2 physical clientsLaptop center 0 + Pi center 5 in the recorded demonstration
Continued trainingThe presentation path can warm-start from a fixed federated checkpoint
Dense payload remainsFreezing reduces Pi compute but not the estimated 44.7 MB raw parameter payload
Local tunnel onlyCurrent Flower transport is kept on loopback / SSH; TLS and node identity are future work

Replay provenance: the archived hardware run used the earlier capped-example weighting reported in its artifact (n = 128 for both clients). The current local Flower path instead uses full partition cardinality for FedAvg and reports processed examples separately.

06 Reproducibility

Trace every number back to code

Every training run records its configuration, seed, commit, dependency context and output metrics.

Dataset

Fed-ISIC2019

23,247 dermoscopy images, eight diagnostic classes, six natural centers originating from four source institutions.

Model

ResNet-18 + GroupNorm

A consistent architecture across centralized, federated and privacy comparisons; class-weighted cross-entropy handles imbalance.

Primary metric

Balanced accuracy

Per-class recall averaged across all eight classes. Random reference: 0.125.

Execution

Two honest paths

Six clients sequentially on one training host, or two Flower clients plus a coordinator in separate local processes.

Enable genuine training on your own licensed dataRun from the repository root
DATA_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/fed_isic2019/raw make demo-site

For a safe end-to-end check without private data, run make demo-site-fixture. The interface then says “SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — REAL TRAINING” and never presents fixture scores as medical evidence.

Historical evidence manifests record a dirty worktree, so exact source reconstruction for those archived results is incomplete. New runs preserve the current commit and run configuration; regenerate clean tagged evidence before a formal release.

07 Safety & validity ledger

What this project proves—and what it does not

Industry-quality work makes its assurance boundary visible.

Demonstrated

Federated optimization

Six natural non-IID partitions train one shared model while update payloads exclude training images; the single-host path provides logical, not storage, isolation.

Demonstrated

Research DP accounting

DP-SGD uses per-sample clipping, Gaussian noise, actual logical step counts and an independent RDP accountant.

Current limitation

DP release boundary

Top-line spend covers completed rounds; client status records each completed update. Test evaluation and metadata remain outside the budget, and spend resets per run.

Current limitation

Evaluation isolation

Historical checkpoints were selected on test performance, and live evaluation is centrally pooled each round.

Current limitation

Network security

The Flower demo is not production TLS/mTLS, authenticated node identity, or operating-system data isolation.

Current limitation

Clinical validity

No external clinical validation, calibration, subgroup fairness study or regulatory assessment has been completed.

Next engineering step

Production federation

Federated validation, client identity, TLS, durable job recovery, networked DP and production secure aggregation.
